'''2016 MPC Kristian Lund DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kristian Lund]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kristian Lund]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
